lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs are arranged in distinct vertical columns; the first clearly defined column posterior to the gill slits contains five primary nodes, with subsequent posterior columns exhibiting a staggered, approximately linear vertical distribution.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal alignment of blobs, forming a localized grid pattern most prominent in the mid-lateral region posterior to the pectoral fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient (bright dorsal edge, shadowed ventral edge) traverse the longitudinal axis of the visible upper flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct reddish-pink circular mark, consistent with a parasitic lesion or localized abrasion, is visible on the upper flank approximately three columns posterior to the gill slits.
